berlekamp1968.author: E. R. Berlekamp
berlekamp1968.title: A Construction for Partitions Which Avoid Long Arithmetic Progressions
berlekamp1968.role: Verified finite three-colour baselines at progression lengths 12 through 28

specializations.winning_case: At length 24, t=23 and denominator 2 give 23*(3^23-1)/2=1082646556499; length monotonicity carries this bound to length 25.
specializations.condition_check: Each registered seed stores the maximum denominator required by Berlekamp's conditions (4) and (5), and its exact quotient is covered by the closure tests. Exhaustive evaluation for progression lengths 3 through 11 proves that their largest value, 7651 at length 8, is below the registered length-12 value 974303, so starting the closure at length 12 cannot omit a stronger Berlekamp monotone predecessor.

cfs2026.author: Marcelo Campos, Jacob Fox, and Carl Schildkraut
cfs2026.title: A new lower bound for two-color van der Waerden numbers
cfs2026.role: Version-pinned explicit finite two-colour product seeds for lengths 17 through 28; all are dominated in the audited comparison
cfs2026.condition_check: For each registered length, the closure tests exhaustively enumerate all subsets of distinct primes summing to k-1, verify that the stored decomposition maximizes the explicit product, and recompute its exact strict integer.

gasarch2011.title: Lower Bounds on van der Waerden Numbers: Randomized- and Deterministic-Constructive
gasarch2011.role: Explicit finite three-colour family for lengths 17 through 28; retained but dominated throughout the audited comparison
gasarch2011.condition_check: Exact rational enclosures of e certify every stored floor(3^(k-1)/(e*k)); no floating-point approximation is accepted as evidence.
